headline: KoBold Metals Says DRC Lithium Project Could Face One-Year Delay
summary: Backed by Bill Gates and Jeff Bezos, KoBold Metals stated that its $50 million search for lithium in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be delayed by a year due to pending United Nations approvals for surveying equipment.
why: Mineral exploration projects require specialized equipment and regulatory clearances, impacting the future supply pipeline of critical battery minerals.

impacts.name: KoBold Metals
impacts.why: Operational delays can postpone project timelines and alter exploration expenditure schedules.
